name: taskboard
description: Live task board in the crab style: a band with the current task, a 3/7 bar and a Tasks button; a Tasks pane with one crab per task (sleeping, working with the tool it uses, happy, angry), a live activity line, a mini Gantt timeline and per-task tool-call and token estimates. Hooks only, zero tokens.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr or ar (right to left)

subagentTasks.title: Show subagent tasks
subagentTasks.description: List the tasks a subagent creates in their own group under the main tasks

showTimeline.title: Timeline chart
showTimeline.description: Show the mini Gantt chart (start to end of each task) in the Tasks pane
